New mcq total ~9697 (was 6637). MCQ_SYS prompt updated: infer the answer letter from explanation prose; ignore peer-% as key; strip PassMed UI. _run_test now strided-samples across BOTH kinds so it validates qbank stitched-unit parsing + re-extrapolates cost.
